justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a private project and upload target or enqueues a source import, and records an access audit.
justifications.open_world_justification: Imports media with an external read into private storage without publishing content or changing the source system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates new project and source records without deleting or overwriting an existing project.

justifications.read_only_justification: Enqueues transcription and updates the private project transcript, layout and version, with an access audit.
justifications.open_world_justification: Processes audio through private ElevenLabs or Gemini transcription services and does not publish media or captions.
justifications.destructive_justification: Regeneration replaces current caption layout and manual grouping without a complete layout snapshot, although transcript revisions are retained.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves the owned project and bounded transcript window while persisting a redacted access audit.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads private workspace records and cannot publish or send them to external recipients.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite project content; its access audit is append-only.

justifications.read_only_justification: Updates private words, timing, style, layout or title after checking the current project version and records an audit.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only the authenticated workspace project and cannot publish it or message external recipients.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can overwrite layout, styling and title without full historical snapshots; version checks prevent stale edits and transcript edits retain parent revisions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Persists an export quote or, after explicit approval, creates a render task and reserves and settles existing credits.
justifications.open_world_justification: Renders private downloadable files in application storage without posting to social media or other public destinations.
justifications.destructive_justification: An approved successful export consumes credits irreversibly; immutable quotes, explicit cost approval and idempotency prevent unapproved or duplicate charges.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves task state and completed output metadata while persisting a redacted access audit.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads private task records and scoped downloads without publishing public content.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not cancel tasks or delete or overwrite their outputs; its access audit is append-only.

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes a private queued or running task to request cancellation and releases its reserved credits when cancelled.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes private application work only and does not publish content or affect public destinations.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cancellation is terminal and discards incomplete outputs for that task; completed tasks cannot be cancelled and the source project remains available.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves caption presets and guidance while persisting a redacted access audit.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads a first-party preset catalog without changing public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify presets or projects; its access audit is append-only.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns the video-upload start card while persisting a redacted access audit; upload preparation requires a separate action.
justifications.open_world_justification: Displays first-party UI without publishing media or writing to public destinations.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite project content; its access audit is append-only.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves the private project and presets for the picker while persisting a redacted access audit; applying a style is separate.
justifications.open_world_justification: Displays private project data and first-party presets without public publication.
justifications.destructive_justification: Opening the picker does not overwrite the project; its access audit is append-only.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves the private project and bounded words for the editor while persisting a redacted access audit; edits are separate calls.
justifications.open_world_justification: Displays private workspace content without public publication or external messaging.
justifications.destructive_justification: Opening the editor does not overwrite project content; its access audit is append-only.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves task state for a progress card while persisting a redacted access audit.
justifications.open_world_justification: Displays private job and output state without publishing public content.
justifications.destructive_justification: Opening progress does not cancel tasks or remove outputs; its access audit is append-only.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a private project or short-lived upload target for a user-selected file and records an access audit.
justifications.open_world_justification: Prepares upload into private first-party storage and cannot publish the media.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates upload records without deleting existing projects and avoids replacing an already-ready source.

test_cases.user_prompt: Add captions to a video I upload and let me choose a style.
test_cases.expected_output: Upload a short talking-head MP4 in a fresh chat; receive timed captions and the style editor with muted looping playback when allowed; no paid render or credit reservation occurs. Live execution pending.

test_cases.description: Choose and persist a caption style
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the available caption styles, then move the captions to the top.
test_cases.expected_output: The selected preset and top placement persist after reopening, the project version increases and no paid render starts. Live execution pending.

test_cases.user_prompt: Help me review my video's captions and correct a word before exporting.
test_cases.expected_output: Only the explicitly requested word changes; the version increases and the saved correction remains after reopening, with unrelated words unchanged. Live execution pending.

test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the cost to export my captioned video as an MP4 with an SRT file.
test_cases.expected_output: Quote creates no task or charge; exact-cost approval starts one export; MP4 and SRT contain the correction, and repeating the same idempotency key creates no duplicate task or charge. Live execution pending.
An accepted cancellation becomes terminal, releases reserved credits and leaves no completed task outputs; a task already finished is not a successful cancellation case. Live execution pending.
